description: 2D game loops, rendering surfaces, geometry, event handling, timers, sound, and collision morphisms.

typestates.uninitialized: Resource or engine subsystem not yet allocated or initialized.
typestates.initialized: Resource or engine subsystem allocated and initialized into operational state.
typestates.active: Resource actively in use and available for morphism transformations.
typestates.modified: Resource mutated during step transformation morphism.
typestates.rendered: Buffer or surface updated with graphical primitives ready for display.
typestates.display_surface: Primary hardware frame buffer Surface bound to the display window.
typestates.flushed: Frame buffer swapped or output committed to terminal sink.
typestates.closed: Resource deallocated or subsystem shut down.
typestates.geometry: Rect or spatial bounding box representation.
typestates.geometry_list: Sequence of Rect objects representing multi-region geometries.
typestates.dimensions: Width and height pair defining spatial bounds.
typestates.coordinate_list: Sequence of 2D Cartesian coordinates defining paths or polygons.
typestates.color_object: Pygame Color instance supporting color space math and interpolation.
typestates.loop_condition: Boolean continuation flag for iterative cycles.
typestates.event_queue: Sequence of pending window or operating system events.
typestates.event_object: Individual event message representing user or system input.
typestates.key_map: Sequence or map of physical keys to boolean pressed states.
typestates.mouse_state: Mouse cursor state or button depressed flags.
typestates.time_delta: Elapsed time in milliseconds between frame steps.
typestates.time_stamp: Absolute millisecond tick counter since engine initialization.
typestates.sound_handle: Decoded audio sample ready for mixer playback.
typestates.font_handle: Raster font resource ready for glyph rendering.
typestates.index_state: Integer index indicating position or result code.
typestates.terminated: Terminal state signifying completed iteration or cycle.
typestates.sprite_handle: Autonomous game entity encapsulating Surface and Rect states.
typestates.group_handle: Container holding homogeneous collection of sprite morphisms.
typestates.mask_handle: 1-bit per pixel alpha silhouette mask for precise collision.
typestates.scalar_magnitude: Floating point scalar representing magnitude or normalized factor.
